sights.address: Onnebetsu, Shari, Shari District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Five forest lakes under the Shiretoko range inside the UNESCO World Natural Heritage site — an 800 m bear-proof elevated boardwalk plus guided ground trails.

sights.address: Iwaobetsu, Shari, Shari District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: 'The Maiden's Tears' — groundwater seeping straight out of a sea cliff into the Sea of Okhotsk, twenty minutes' walk from the Shiretoko Nature Center.

sights.n: Oshinkoshin Falls (オシンコシンの滝)
sights.address: Chashikotsu, Shari, Shari District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Twin-stream roadside falls on the way to Utoro, one of Japan's 100 best waterfalls, with a stair up to the mid-fall viewpoint.

sights.address: Shiretoko-tōge, between Utoro (Shari) and Rausu, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The 738 m road pass across the peninsula, facing Mount Rausu and, across the strait, Kunashiri Island; open roughly May to early November.
The Ainu 'Lake of the Gods': a 212 m-deep caldera with no inlet or outlet, famous for 'Mashū blue' clarity — and its fogs.

sights.address: Akanko Onsen, Akan-chō, Kushiro, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Crater lake under Me-Akan and O-Akan, home of the spherical marimo algae, with the Akankohan onsen town on its shore.
Japan's largest caldera lake — hot sand you dig into at Sunayu, open-air shore baths and winter swans.

sights.address: Kawayu Onsen, Teshikaga, Kawakami District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The Ainu 'naked mountain': a bare, yellow-crusted active volcano hissing sulphur steam beside Kawayu Onsen.

sights.n: Abashiri Prison Museum (博物館 網走監獄)
sights.w: The Meiji prison that built Hokkaido's roads, rebuilt as an open-air museum — the five-winged radial cell block, court, bathhouse and punishment cells.

sights.n: Kushiro Marsh — Kushiro-shitsugen National Park (釧路湿原)
sights.address: Hosooka Observatory (細岡展望台), Kushiro-chō, Kushiro District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Japan's largest wetland and first Ramsar site (1980) — the stronghold of the red-crowned crane, seen from the Hosooka and marsh observatories.

sights.n: Kanemori Red Brick Warehouses (金森赤レンガ倉庫)
sights.w: 1909 harbour warehouses (founded 1887) turned shops, beer hall and event space in 1988 — Hakodate's waterfront landmark.

sights.n: Ōnuma Quasi-National Park (大沼国定公園)
sights.address: Ōnuma-chō, Nanae, Kameda District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Island-dotted Ōnuma and Konuma ponds under the volcano Hokkaidō-Komagatake — 126 islets linked by bridges, boating and cycling 30 minutes from Hakodate.
The northernmost point you can stand on in Japan — the triangular monument, Sakhalin on the horizon on a clear day.

sights.n: Rishiri Island & Mount Rishiri (利尻島・利尻山)
sights.address: Rishiri / Rishirifuji, Rishiri District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A dormant 1,721 m volcano rising straight from the sea — 'Rishiri-Fuji' — ringed by a cycling road and kelp-drying beaches; ferry from Wakkanai.
The 'floating island of flowers' — alpine flowers found nowhere else bloom at sea level June–August along the Momoiwa and Cape Sukoton trails.
